messages:
Rina: Heads-up 15min sync: we need a short, copy-first migration playbook for v1->v2 (focus: examples + quick fixes). Keep PRs < 10 files.
Caleb: I'll swap TS + Py snippets and open small PRs. Plan: one language per PR.
Maya: I'll audit docs for `invoke(` and old model IDs, list findings here.
Rina: Tag all PRs with `docs/migrate` and add a one-line migration note in the PR body.
Caleb: Example replacement for TS:
```ts
// OLD
await client.invoke({ model: 'r-chat', prompt })
// NEW
const res = await client.responses.create({ model: 'r-chat-2024-02', input: prompt })
console.log(res.output[0].content.map(c => c.text).join('\n'))
```
Maya: Found 12 hits in `website/` and 3 in `examples/`. Posting PRs in batches of 3.
Tony: I'll prepare redirects for renamed pages; prefer redirects over renames. I'll add `scripts/validate-redirects.js` changes if needed.
docs-bot: New PR created by Caleb: https://github.com/redwood-inference/website/pull/9001 
QA: Smoke plan: `yarn build`, `yarn start`, `npm run smoke:examples`. Will flag any `.text` top-level assumptions.
Rina: Add a small helper snippet `docs.utils.extractText(res)` so examples don't show array traversal. Link it in the playbook.
Caleb: Marking bounty-eligible PRs I land with `bounty-eligible`.
Maya: First batch PRs opened. Will post results after CI.
docs-bot: CI passed on 2 PRs, 4 pending.
QA: One snippet failed (curl lacked header). Filed fix PR.
Rina: Great. When everything merges, I'll publish a short deprecation note in /docs/news and ping #general. Close thread after deploy check.
